title: Emily Lawrence

---

SPG missionary at Tamatave, Madagascar.

She was the founder of several girls\' schools in Madagascar, and was invalided home by the SPG in 1899.

She had also worked in Mauritius.

She died in an SPG hostel in Worthing.

Death announcement, The Times (14 October 1914).
